description.text: Introduction: In 2000 the doctor program was established. The main research areas include mechanical strength and design/design methodology/optimization, reliability and CAD/industrial design. Many valuable research achievements and publications had been completed. About forty research projects of state-level are being carried out now. The research team and groups have professional research and teaching experiences. Most of the teachers had studied in USA/European countries /Australia. Research fields: Mechanical Strength and Design Mechatronic System and its Testing and Controlling Technology Modern Design and Manufacturing Theory and Methods Weapon Launch Theory and Technology Engineering Materials and Material Strength Intelligent Structures of Optical Fiber Core classes: Marxism Theory, First Foreign Language, Application of Advanced Math, Modern Mechanical Design Theory, Numerical Control Technology, Mechanical CAD and Simulation, Theory of Material Strength I, Intelligent Structures of Optical Fiber, Second Foreign Language, Academic Report and Seminar

duration.text: The Mechanical Design and Theory at Harbin Engineering University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/In total ￥ 45000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens 2.In good health 3.Master Degree in related courses 4.language proficiency: TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (the student, who is from English countries or his/her mother language is English, needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate).
